steps.body: Barcode, RFID and marking give every product an identity, on the line and in the warehouse.
Odoo, Microsoft 365 and custom applications turn that data into processes and decisions.
Cybersecurity keeps your systems available and your data safe; our content carries your image.

about.metaDescription: LINTON is a Moroccan group with three business lines: industrial identification and traceability, development and cloud solutions, cybersecurity and media.

header.title: One brand, three businesses
header.lead: LINTON supports industrial and service companies through their transformation, from the shop floor to the cloud.

story.title:
Born on the
industrial floor
paragraphs: LINTON grew out of industrial identification and traceability: equipping production lines and warehouses so every product can be tracked, from raw-material batch to shipment.

By integrating those systems with our customers' ERPs, we naturally extended our expertise to development, Odoo and Microsoft 365, then to cybersecurity — because data that is captured and used must also be protected.
Today the group brings these three business lines together under one brand, with specialised teams and a single standard.
